purpose: Mandatory high-risk Linux integration scenarios supplementing the canonical module acceptance matrix.

assertions: approved-reference or production scope is explicit
FASTA SHA-256 matches manifest
every BLAST/MFEprimer index artifact SHA-256 matches manifest
corrupting one copied index artifact causes strict refusal
smoke-regression scope never becomes a production specificity claim
PrimalScheme3 and Olivar remain independent named backends and the actual primary backend/version is retained in result provenance
backend outputs are not averaged into a synthetic universal tiling score or protocol
PrimalScheme scheme-create retains artifacts/hashes and pool interaction evidence
Olivar variant-aware design retains its own risk/optimization authority and circular use remains fail-closed unless coordinate/export support is explicitly qualified
ARTIC BED/export semantics remain separate from wet-lab protocol chemistry
BED regions use 0-based half-open semantics
coverage denominator is the merged requested region span
absolute-reference coverage map remains correctly oriented
reviewed BED, MSA and config are required and fingerprinted
repair artifacts are retained
malformed imports produce typed refusal
named primer replacement uses the exact 3.3.0 positional contract
ambiguous named replacement refuses rather than guessing
updated artifact identity is retained
external validation receives selected final oligos, not discarded candidates
PrimerPooler groups by actual tube before pool fallback
strict incomplete/limited evidence fails closed
named Thermo Fisher conventional and IDT PrimeTime conventional hydrolysis-probe branches are executable under their own authority without averaging numeric rules
MGB/NFQ exact-Tm ranking requires a hash-bound external MGB-aware authority result; ordinary-DNA Tm is never substituted
probe salt/oligo thermodynamic context is explicit and same-reaction consistency is checked rather than silently diverging from primer context
F/R/probe self/cross interaction and independent structure evidence remain visible diagnostics/validators with provenance
MIQE/workflow evidence, multiplex optics and observed validation data never silently mutate saved design ranking
pydna is OPTIONAL unless the corresponding feature is selected
when available/selected, simulation result is attached as independent evidence
absence does not become an unrelated hard prerequisite
auto runs MAFFT-first policy with provenance
prealigned preserves reviewed alignment authority
alignment version/depth/width/warnings are retained
F3/B3/FIP/BIP are the four core oligos
LF/LB remain optional
six core target regions are modeled
readout is provenance and does not fabricate ranking evidence
partition format, platform identity and fragmentation state are explicit
generic workflow says partition rather than droplet
QX200 overlay requires droplet partition format
droplet-specific terms occur only under a ddPCR/platform overlay
fragmentation is never silently inferred
threshold/rain/accepted-partition/Poisson outputs remain measured-run evidence
TwistAmp Basic/Basic RT executable branch works
Exo/Nfo/Fpg/SIBA modified-probe requests never fabricate plain ACGT probes
unsupported topology returns a typed boundary/refusal
same-enzyme ends are accepted as nondirectional when otherwise valid
directionality risk and control/screening requirements are visible
different-enzyme directional strategy remains supported
host class, crude-template preparation, protocol/SOP identity and separate source/revision provenance are required
no universal lysis hold or cycle count is inferred
result remains in-silico-screen-design until bench observations are supplied
colony-only fields refuse on unrelated flanking assays
5prime/3prime direction maps to the correct single-primer read strand
GeneRacer and current FirstChoice RLM-RACE resolve exact versioned PCR partners by direction and primary/nested round
conflicting raceChemistry/raceAdapter kit identities refuse instead of cross-wiring partner sequences
SMARTer current-assisted execution requires complete context and an explicit exact partner; source-limited family metadata remains non-executable
substrate, preparation and primary/nested round are retained
result says candidate-transcript-end and never claims transcript-end completeness without sequencing evidence
design profile constraints remain separate from provider submission concentration/volume requirements
instrument family or explicit unresolved state is retained and other instrument requires a name
facility SOP may be retained independently of chemistry overlay
universal-primer reuse is executable only for exact unique template binding and cannot silently replace a ranked designed primer on ambiguous/non-unique binding
trace/basecalling/quality remain evidence from the external sequencing run and do not retroactively mutate saved ranking
weighted and stratified policies consume caller-supplied panel metadata without converting user weights into population prevalence claims
finite non-target specificity reports supplied-panel scope only
exact enumerated degenerate members remain traceable to mixed-base/defined-pool/discrete-mixture formulation evidence
split-pool and amplicon-informativeness outputs are diagnostic and do not silently rewrite primary ranking
alternative-alignment sensitivity is preserved as validation evidence with tool/version/provenance
biallelic-genotype refuses insertion/deletion/complex/presence-absence and remains the SNV/MNV single-anchor branch
presence-absence uses a reference-present representation with non-empty REF and empty ALT; reference-absence additions use insertion instead
typed insertion/deletion/presence-absence variant can execute the junction-aware plus/minus branch
current KASP protocol identity remains separate from historical lgc-standard compatibility
FAM/HEX endpoint import preserves plate/well/provider/software evidence
provider calls are preserved but PCRStudio does not invent a universal cluster threshold or hidden genotype auto-call
no result claims proprietary Kraken-equivalent design
neb-e5510 is executable only with method=gibson
neb-nebuilder-e2621/e5520/e2623 are executable only with method=nebuilder
Gibson and NEBuilder overlap/input numeric authorities never cross-inherit
typed fragment production and circular construct graph survive fork/export round-trip
feature/frame/molarity outputs remain diagnostic/provenance rather than fabricated measurements
single DNA, multi-edit, amino-acid and library input modes have independent required-context branches
Q5, QuikChange single and Lightning Multi keep distinct topology/protocol/Tm rules
Q5 7-100 nt insertion uses split tails and >100 nt routes to assembly instead of being silently truncated
NEBuilder multi-site remains a typed route to Junction Primers rather than an orderable mutagenic pair
switching away from library mode cannot leave a hidden stale library payload active
Round 1 and Round 2 chemistry/thermal programs remain independently identified
direct/diluted/purified/custom and named Exonuclease I transfer modes preserve explicit provenance
outer off-target products are rescanned with inner primers to produce the causal nested false-product graph
generic one-tube Nested remains fail-closed
anonymous dUTP/UNG remains strategy-only unless a named compatible protocol is selected
standard restriction/self-ligation requires zero internal anchor cuts and explicit digest/circularization provenance
supplied circular template does not invent a digest or ligation protocol
one-sided/internal-cut strategy remains reference-only and cannot silently substitute for the standard branch
exact, bounded and unresolved product-length states are preserved without fabricating unknown flank sequence
sequencing confirmation is a handoff/evidence route rather than duplicated sequencing-primer logic
